mapper.insert: insert ignore into t_message_blacklist (userId, blockedUserId, createTime) values (#{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{blockedUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, now())
mapper.select: select b.id, b.userId, b.blockedUserId, b.createTime, u.id as "blockedUser.id", u.username as "blockedUser.username", u.nickname as "blockedUser.nickname", u.avatarUrl as "blockedUser.avatarUrl" from t_message_blacklist b inner join t_user u on b.blockedUserId = u.id where b.userId = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} order by b.createTime desc

select id, postUserId, receiveUserId, state, createTime from t_message where ((postUserId = #{userA,jdbcType=BIGINT} and receiveUserId = #{userB,jdbcType=BIGINT}) or (postUserId = #{userB,jdbcType=BIGINT} and receiveUserId = #{userA,jdbcType=BIGINT})) and deleteState = 0 order by id desc limit 1
